1.title: AI Gateway Token Traffic Growing 140X Year Over Year | Aghi Marietti
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Kong CEO on AI gateway architecture as security/cost control layer — token traffic growing 140X YoY, multi-model routing, kill switches for runaway spend, enterprise adoption patterns.

1.title: Claude Engineering Lead: "Stop Using Claude Like It’s 2024"
1.author: Silicon Valley Girl
1.hook: Claude engineering lead (Felix Rieseberg) on moving beyond summarization tasks — how to frame goals instead of tasks, catch confident mistakes, build agents that do work you couldn't do alone, and stop being the bottleneck.

2.title: Человек, который предсказал TikTok и соцсети — о том, что ждёт нас в эпоху ИИ
2.author: Marina Mogilko
2.hook: Marina Mogilko interviews Gary Vainerchuk on AI-era opportunities, content strategy, hiring in an AI world, and wealth-building amid middle-class pressure. Topics include personal brand durability, offline channels, and entrepreneurship principles.

3.title: The Only 7 Books You Need to Educate Yourself Like the Top 1%
3.author: Sandeep Swadia
3.hook: Meta-analysis of 7 books filtered through a 3-gate system, targeting cognitive failure modes (survivorship bias, identity-locked thinking, outcome reasoning, high-IQ rationalization).

1.title: Traditional Aerospace Supply Chains Are Cooked | Blake Scholl
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Blake Scholl discusses Boom Supersonic's pivot to 42-megawatt power generation turbines for AI data centers, vertical integration bypassing aerospace supply chains, and plans for an all-digital single-crystal turbine blade foundry.

2.title: The Marketing GENIUS: How To Build A Brand That Sells In The New Era Of AI (3 Laws Of Marketing)
2.author: The Calum Johnson Show
2.hook: Seth Godin on brand-building fundamentals in the AI era — timestamps cover idea validation, customer trust, referrals, and retention, but no specifics on how AI changes these mechanics.

1.title: This Is How You Should Actually Make Launch Videos
1.author: Y Combinator
1.hook: Founder of Hey Clicky and Buildspace shares a playbook for treating demos as launches: scripting videos to sound unscripted, the "did my eyes stop" test for attention, why 20k YouTube views can outconvert 3M Twitter views, and choosing channels by conversion not vanity metrics.

1.title: How to Tell Stories Better Than 99% of People
1.author: Shannon Jenkins
1.hook: Video breaking down Ted Lasso scenes to extract storytelling techniques (curiosity, tension, pacing, specificity) and introduces the CART framework (Context, Action, Result, Takeaway) for business storytelling.
